author: Dale Philip
description:
I tried this traditional Betawi food that's made from a mixture of grated coconut and starch that's cooked in a special shaped mold and is covered with a sweet brown sugar syrup.

Despite it being a local food from this area of Indonesia it was very difficult to find. I found it at Setu Babakan which is a cultural heritage site for Betawi culture.
title: Trying 'Kue Rangi' in Jakarta, Indonesia 🇮🇩
